hints.content: Growth at a rate of $30\%$ means the population keeps its $100\%$ and adds $30\%$ more, for a total of $130\%$.
So each year, the population size is multiplied by $130\%$, which is the same as a factor of $1.3$.

If we start with the initial population size, $170$ deer, and keep multiplying by $1.3$, this function gives us the deer population $t$ years from now:

$P(t)=170(1.3)^t$
